parameters.note: Tahoe-tributary check (required for Tahoe-basin waters): Miller Creek (Placer Co.) is a small west-flowing stream in the McKinney–Rubicon area whose mouth meets the Rubicon River (traced in OpenStreetMap; Miller Creek mouth ~39.0265, -120.2534 adjacent to the Rubicon River channel). It therefore drains to the Middle Fork American River, NOT into Lake Tahoe, and is NOT a Lake Tahoe tributary — so the §7.50(b)(152) 'Tahoe Lake tributaries' special closure does NOT apply. (This Miller Creek is west of the Sierra crest and is distinct from the McKinney Creek chain that drains east into Lake Tahoe.) Miller Creek is also not listed by its own name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide stream regulation §5.85(a)(2): open with a five-trout bag from the last Saturday in April through November 15, then a zero-trout catch-and-release period with gear restrictions from November 16 through the Friday preceding the last Saturday in April.

end.verbatim: the Friday preceding the last Saturday in April

candidates.summary: Open the last Saturday in April through November 15 (general statewide stream regulation — drains west to the Rubicon River, not a Lake Tahoe tributary, so the §7.50(b)(152) Tahoe closure does not apply); November 16 through the Friday preceding the last Saturday in April is a zero-trout, artificial-lures-with-barbless-hooks period

parameters.note: Gear restriction applies from November 16 through the Friday preceding the last Saturday in April, for all species of fish. During the regular season (last Saturday in April through November 15) the general stream regulation imposes no gear restrictions.
